question: Chandigarh International Airport has been renamed as ________.
solution:
Correct Answer: __**Shaheed Bhagat Singh International Airport**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**Explanation:**

 
• Chandigarh International Airport has been renamed as Shaheed Bhagat Singh International Airport.
 
• The renaming of the airport was done in honour of Shaheed Bhagat Singh, a prominent Indian freedom fighter and revolutionary who played a significant role in the Indian independence movement.
 
• The airport is located in Chandigarh, the capital city of the states of Punjab and Haryana in India.

• Manmohan Singh International Airport: No official renaming has been done to the airport in the name of Manmohan Singh.
 
• Guru Gobind Singh International Airport: This airport is located in Amritsar, Punjab, and has not been renamed as Chandigarh International Airport.
 
• Rajguru International Airport: No official renaming has been done to the airport in the name of Rajguru.
